# doom

The built, playable site for a DOOM-in-TypeScript experiment with swappable
screen presenters (canvas, React row gradients, React declarative, React per
pixel): https://ryancolton.github.io/doomJavascript/

This repository holds only the build output and is published automatically.
The engine is a TypeScript port of the original DOOM source
(https://github.com/id-Software/DOOM, via https://github.com/kant003/doomJavascript),
licensed GPL-2.0 (see LICENSE.TXT). The complete corresponding source for this
build, including the presenter changes, is available on request from the
repository owner, as the license requires.
